mathematical_proofs.name: Mixed_Boolean_Arithmetic_64Bit_ASLR_Pointer_Decryption
mathematical_proofs.proof: Notice that kMask1 (0x00A060400A021040) and kMask3 (0x0000010400040400) are bit-disjoint (kMask1 & kMask3 == 0) and their union equals kMask2 (kMask1 | kMask3 == 0x00A061440A061440). Therefore, for any code anchor X (x9 = 0x038a58 in sub_38a58 or x25 = 0x03c670 in sub_3c670), ((kMask1 | ~X) & kMask2) + (X & kMask3) evaluates deterministically to 0x00A061440A061440ULL, and ORing with 0x01010104ULL yields 0x00A061440B071544ULL. XORing with K_xor = 0xFF5F9EBBF4517B04ULL (in sub_38a58) yields 0xFFFFFFFFFF566E40ULL (-0xA991C0), which resolves .data 0x04eea8 (r_addend = 0x00AA8D7F) to .rodata 0x00FC3F and 0x04eeb0 (r_addend = 0x00AA8D84) to .rodata 0x00FC44. XORing with K_xor = 0xFF5F9EBBF47FBB9CULL (in sub_3c670) yields 0xFFFFFFFFFF78AED8ULL (-0x875128), which resolves all 47 R_AARCH64_RELATIVE entries in .data 0x04ef70..0x04f0e0 to exact .rodata (0x010850..0x010bb0) and .bss (0x050358..0x0504c4) addresses.

mathematical_proofs.name: OLLVM_Flattened_RC4_256Byte_SBox_KSA_and_PRGA
mathematical_proofs.formula: KSA: S[i]=i, K[i]=key[i mod key_len], j=(j+S[i]+K[i]) mod 256, swap(S[i],S[j]); PRGA: i=(i+1) mod 256, j=(j+S[i]) mod 256, swap(S[i],S[j]), out[k] = ct[k] ^ S[(S[i]+S[j]) mod 256]
mathematical_proofs.proof: At 0x01bab0..0x01bb30, 16 32-bit OLLVM state constants are loaded into w0..w12, w17, w24, w30. State 0x504D3009 (0x01bcb4..0x01bcd0) executes `udiv w16, w14, w27; strb w14, [x20, w14, uxtw]; msub w16, w16, w27, w14; ldrb w16, [x25, w16, uxtw]; strb w16, [x21, w14, uxtw]` to populate S[0..255] at sp+0x120 (x20) and K[0..255] at sp+0x20 (x21). State 0xFFAFB94C (0x01bb64..0x01bb8c) permutes S[0..255]. State 0xB46D15B3 (0x01bd40..0x01bd88) advances w14=(w14+1)&0xFF, w15=(w15+S[w14])&0xFF, swaps S[w14] and S[w15], and XORs ct[w13] with S[(S[w14]+S[w15])&0xFF]. Verified across all 185 call sites in .text (e.g., 0x00b100[14] -> '/proc/self/exe', 0x00fa38[4] -> 'njss', 0x00fc3f[5] -> '38816').

mathematical_proofs.name: OLLVM_Number_Theoretic_Quadratic_NonResidue_Mod7_and_Mod19_Opaque_Predicates
mathematical_proofs.formula: For all x in Z: (x^2 + 1) mod 7 != 0 and 4*(x^2 + 1) mod 19 != 0
mathematical_proofs.proof: Since 7 == 3 (mod 4) and 19 == 3 (mod 4), Euler's criterion states that (-1)^((p-1)/2) == -1 (mod p), meaning -1 is a quadratic non-residue modulo 7 and modulo 19. At 0x038a9c..0x038ac4, libnms.so computes w8 = x^2 + 1 (with x = 0xcf = 207) and divides by 7 using magic reciprocal 0x24924925 (`umull x9, w8, w9; lsr x9, x9, #32; sub w10, w8, w9; add w9, w9, w10, lsr #1; lsr w9, w9, #2`), verifying w8 - 7*q != 0. At 0x014d28..0x014d64 and 0x034994..0x0349c4, libnms.so computes w8 = 4*x^2 + 4 and divides by 19 using magic reciprocal 0xAF286BCB (`lsr #4`), verifying w8 - 19*q != 0. The false branches contain deliberate invalid/SVE opcodes (`0x0591cace`, `0xa303bfcc`) to defeat linear-sweep disassemblers.

mathematical_proofs.name: Indirect_Jump_Target_Decoding_in_JNI_OnLoad_and_CesMetaEntry
mathematical_proofs.proof: In JNI_OnLoad (0x015074), sub_14bd4 decrypts .rodata 0x00b1e4 ^ 0x00b1ec -> '5256'. Then sub_159f4 parses 5256, sub_153f4 returns shift 2 (5256 >> 2 = 1314 = 0x522), and 0x015140..0x015158 computes (0x014ddc - 0x522) + 0x522 == 0x014ddc (sub_14ddc) before calling sub_3c108 (`br x0`). In sub_38a58 (0x038a58), sub_1bde4 RC4-decrypts .rodata 0x00fc3f with key 0x00fc44 -> '38816'. Then 38816 >> 2 = 9704 = 0x25e8, and 0x038bd8..0x038bf0 computes (0x038c20 - 0x25e8) + 0x25e8 == 0x038c20 (sub_38c20).

mathematical_proofs.name: Shifted_AArch64_Direct_Syscall_Bridge_Bias_0xE9
mathematical_proofs.proof: At 0x03c0bc, `sub x0, x0, #0xe9; mov x8, x0; mov x0, x1; ...; svc #0` subtracts 0xE9 (233) from the first argument to obtain the Linux AArch64 syscall number in x8: 0x121 - 0xE9 = 56 (__NR_openat), 0x122 - 0xE9 = 57 (__NR_close), 0x137 - 0xE9 = 78 (__NR_readlinkat), 0x139 - 0xE9 = 80 (__NR_fstat), 0x192 - 0xE9 = 169 (__NR_gettimeofday), 0x195 - 0xE9 = 172 (__NR_getpid), 0x197 - 0xE9 = 174 (__NR_getuid), and 0x19C - 0xE9 = 179 (__NR_sysinfo).
